name: calendar
title: Calendar
description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Calendar (react-day-picker). No frame of its own: put it in a Card, a Popover or an ink-case. Month caption and weekday heads in the uppercase lettering face; square 2px-framed nav buttons with a brush chevron (hover thickens the line, focus is ink / paper / ink). Day cells are cells of a group: hover draws a 1px line inside, focus stays inside the cell. Selected day, range start and range end are ink flats that sweep in over three frames; today is a 2px ink frame (selected wins); the middle of a range is paper with a fine ink line above and below, never a tone behind the number. Outside days keep the same ink in a lighter weight; disabled days get a dashed line-through and a not-allowed cursor. The dropdown caption draws its month and year selects with a 2px line and a brush chevron. Cells are 40px; under 640px they share the available width up to 44px, so a month fits a 360px screen; several months sit side by side from 640px and stack on phones. Same API as the stock Calendar (mode single, multiple, range).
docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/calendar". It wraps your own components/ui/calendar (react-day-picker), which is the same file in Radix and Base UI projects. It has no frame: place it in a Card, a Popover or an element with the ink-case class.
